title: 第三章 鬼车拦路，摸鱼被当成轻生少女
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
这辆大巴车款式老旧，车漆大部分都已经掉落，车头上的电子屏闪着幽幽绿光，在漆黑的晚上显得极其诡异。

    最诡异的是，车上几乎坐满了人，众人的目光都盯着站在路边的姜无念。

    这些人乍看起来和常人无异，但细看却细思极恐，有的人残缺不全，有的血肉模糊，根本看不清容貌。

    姜无念大跨一步上了车，坐在车里唯一的一个空位上，一脸享受得眯着眼往后靠了靠。

    面对周围的诡异目光，她毫不在意，双手环胸闭上眼睛，哼着歌，与车里阴森的气氛显得格格不入。

    大巴车在小路上缓缓行驶，不久后来到一处急弯，峭壁上方挂了一个【事故多发路段】的警示牌。

    车辆偏离了原本的路线，正往急弯处驶去，眼看着就要冲出弯道。

    一直闭着眼的姜无念，突然轻声开口：“如果你们还想投胎转世，就送我到终点站，我今天心情好，投胎前送你们回家看看。”

    一句话，让即将冲下悬崖的大巴车猛地刹住，瞬间又重新出现在了之前正常行驶的道路上，缓缓向前驶去。

    “大师，不是我们不想送您，只是这条路我们已经反复走了十年了，走不出去……根本出不去……”

    司机沙哑的声音从车头传来，冤魂们齐刷刷地看向姜无念，怨气翻涌，周遭空气顿时变得有些阴冷刺骨。

    姜无念没有睁眼，懒懒地说：“开你的就是了。”

    真不懂事，睡觉呢！

    车外迷雾越来越浓，看不清半米以外的景物，车厢内安静得可怕，只微微能听到车轮碾过路面发出的轻响。

    在姜无念说完这句话后，大巴穿过迷雾，竟顺利驶离了那段事故多发地，穿梭在一条新的道路上。

    她感受到周围目光的变化，之前还都是麻木幽怨的眼神，现在全是期待又炙热。

    看啥，这不是基操吗？盯得人难受死了，一群没见过世面的小鬼。

    一眨眼的功夫，大巴车出现在了终点站，一个早在几年前就被废弃的汽车客运站。

    这辆大巴是弯道处的失事车辆，车上的人无一生还。

    众人的执念和怨气太重，导致他们无法投胎转世，只能在出事地点重复着死前的过程。

    “行了，距离天亮还有几个小时，都回去看看吧，但不要和生人靠的太近，你们身上的怨气太重，会影响到活着的人。”
content_en:
This bus was of an old style, with most of its paint peeling off. The electronic screen on the front of the bus shone with a faint green light, which looked extremely strange in the dark night.

    The strangest thing was that the car was almost full of people, and everyone was staring at Jiang Wunian standing on the roadside.

    At first glance, these people look like ordinary people, but upon closer inspection, they are horrifying. Some are mutilated, some are bloody and fleshy, and their appearance cannot be clearly seen at all.

    Jiang Wu Nian took a big step and got into the car, sat on the only empty seat in the car, and leaned back with his eyes narrowed in enjoyment.

    Facing the weird looks around her, she didn't care. She crossed her arms across her chest and closed her eyes, humming a song, which seemed incompatible with the gloomy atmosphere in the car.

    The bus drove slowly on the small road, and soon came to a sharp bend. A warning sign "Accident-prone Road Section" was hung above the cliff.

    The vehicle deviated from its original route and was heading towards a sharp bend, about to exit the bend.

    Jiang Wunian, who had been keeping his eyes closed, suddenly spoke softly: "If you still want to be reincarnated, just send me to the terminal. I am in a good mood today, so I will send you home to see you before reincarnation."

    With one word, the bus that was about to rush off the cliff suddenly stopped, and in an instant it reappeared on the normal road before, and slowly drove forward.

    "Master, it's not that we don't want to see you off, it's just that we have walked this road repeatedly for ten years, and we can't get out... we can't get out at all..."

    The driver's hoarse voice came from the front of the car. The victims all looked at Jiang Wu Nian with resentment rising, and the surrounding air suddenly became a bit cold and biting.

    Jiang Wunian didn't open his eyes and said lazily: "Just drive your car."

    I'm so ignorant, I'm sleeping!

    The fog outside the car is getting thicker and thicker, and it is difficult to see the scenery half a meter away. The inside of the car is eerily quiet, and only the soft sound of the wheels on the road can be heard.

    After Jiang Wu Nian said these words, the bus passed through the fog and successfully left the accident-prone area and shuttled on a new road.

    She felt the changes in the eyes around her. Before, they were numb and resentful, but now they were full of expectation and heat.

    What are you looking at? Isn’t this gay? Staring at them makes people uncomfortable to death, a bunch of brats who have never seen the world.

    In the blink of an eye, the bus appeared at the terminal, a bus terminal that had been abandoned a few years ago.

    This bus was a wrecked vehicle on a curve, and no one on board survived.

    The obsession and resentment of everyone were so great that they were unable to be reincarnated and could only repeat the process of death at the place where the accident occurred.

    "Okay, there are still a few hours until dawn. Let's go back and take a look, but don't get too close to strangers. Your resentment is too heavy and will affect the living people."
title_en: Chapter 3: A ghost car blocks the road, and fishing is treated as a girl who commits suicide
